what_is.heading: What Are COD Points and What Can You Buy With Them?
paragraphs: COD Points (CP) are the premium currency in Call of Duty. You spend them in the store on bundles of operator skins and weapon blueprints, and on the seasonal Battle Pass.
Your CP balance is shared between the current Call of Duty games on the same platform, including Warzone. What you buy with it unlocks on every platform linked to your Activision account.

official_prices.heading: COD Points Prices: Official Store vs DropMarket
official_prices.note: These are US prices. You can buy CP in the in-game store or your platform's store, and the balance only works on the platform where you bought it.

delivery.heading: How COD Points Delivery Works
steps: Pick an offer for the platform you play on: PlayStation, Xbox, Battle.net or Steam.
Read the seller's delivery note before you pay. It says whether you get a code or a top-up.
After checkout, send what the seller asks for in the order chat.
Check your CP balance in the store on that platform, then confirm the order.

support_topic.heading: Do COD Points Transfer Between Platforms?
paragraphs: No. Activision says you can only use COD Points on the platform where you bought them. CP bought on PlayStation won't show up on PC.
Items you buy with CP do carry across, as long as your platforms are linked to the same Activision account. Moving between two consoles of the same family, like PS4 to PS5, keeps your balance.

faq_extra.q: Can you gift COD Points to a friend?
faq_extra.a: No. Activision doesn't let you transfer or gift COD Points to another player.

faq_extra.q: Are COD Points shared with Warzone?
faq_extra.a: Yes, on the same platform. Your balance works across the current Call of Duty games and Warzone.

what_is.heading: What Are COD Points?
what_is.text: COD Points (CP) are Call of Duty's money. You spend them on operator skins, weapon blueprints and the Battle Pass, in Warzone and the current games.

savings.heading: How Much Do You Save on COD Points?
savings.text: The official store sells CP at fixed prices. Sellers here set their own, and many charge less for the same CP.

delivery.text: CP can't be gifted, so you get a code for your platform or the seller tops up your account.

steps.title: Code or Top-Up
steps.body: Redeem your code, or the seller adds CP to your account.

steps.title: CP Arrives
steps.body: Check your CP balance on that platform, then confirm the order.

delivery.tip: COD Points only work on the platform you bought them for, so pick the one you play on.

page.safety_text: Yes. Every order is covered and every seller is ID-checked. If a top-up needs your login, change your password after.

notes: Platform lock and the no-gifting rule are from Activision's Black Ops 6 support article (updated 2024-10-23); I assumed the rule is unchanged for Black Ops 7, so medium confidence. US prices from a third-party guide (lfcarry, Aug 2026); smaller packs (200/500 CP) exist on some stores but weren't confirmed. Our config bundles (4,800, 9,600, 12,000, 21,600, 26,400) aren't official pack sizes; sellers seem to stack packs. 'Shared with Warzone and current games' is general knowledge, consistent with Activision but not quoted from a fetched page. DELIVERY IS UNCLEAR: no live COD listings, generic placeholder. CP can't be gifted, so delivery has to be a platform code or an account top-up; no_password is false. Config regions (US/UK/South Korea) and platforms (lists both 'Battlenet' and 'Battle.net', plus 'PC') need tidying.
